title: Search Filters
description: User interface filters and sorting controls on the worker search screen in Rozgar Connect

filters.name: Category Filter
filters.options: All Services (empty string) or any specific category like plumber, electrician, carpenter, etc.
filters.description: Filters workers by their skillset. The list of categories is loaded dynamically from the backend categories database endpoint. Defaults are used as a fallback if the API is unreachable.

filters.name: City Filter
filters.description: Filters workers by the city they serve. Standardizes input by trimming and converting to lowercase internally when matching.

filters.name: Area Filter
filters.description: Filters workers by their neighborhood or zone within the city. Accessed by clicking the 'Filters' toggle button to open the advanced drawer.

filters.name: Sort By Filter
filters.description: Controls the order of the search results. Newest sorts by profile creation date descending; Highest Rating sorts by worker's averageRating descending; Most Reviews sorts by worker's reviewCount descending.

actions.search: Submits the search form, executing the API call with all defined query params. Triggered by clicking 'Search' or changing core dropdown values.
actions.reset: Resets category, city, area variables to empty strings and sortBy to 'newest'. Triggers a fresh search fetching all workers on the local network.
